description.en-US: Chesterton's first novel: in a London of 1984 grown grey and bureaucratic, a boy who loves his neighbourhood is made king by a joke and takes the joke seriously, and the little streets of Notting Hill go to war for their honour. A fantasy of local patriotism and the lost romance of small things.
description.pt-BR: O primeiro romance de Chesterton: numa Londres de 1984 cinzenta e burocrática, um rei institui por brincadeira o patriotismo dos bairros, e um rapaz que ama Notting Hill leva a brincadeira a sério, e as ruazinhas de Notting Hill vão à guerra pela sua honra. Uma fantasia de patriotismo local e do romance perdido das coisas pequenas.

sources.edition: The Napoleon of Notting Hill (John Lane, 1904), Project Gutenberg #20058.
sources.description: Chapter divisions as printed; Gutenberg front and back matter dropped, line wraps joined, underscored italics converted, double hyphens set as em dashes. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain: Chesterton died in 1936 (more than 70 years ago, so public domain in Brazil, the UK and the EU) and the book was published in 1904 (public domain in the US).
